tasks.notes: Implemented src/lib/prism/player/hub-router.ts (virtual routing node) + window.__prism debug handle + navbar-link active-section latch. buildHomeHubRoutes() derives scroll targets from graph section-bg y positions. Playwright test tests/lib/prism/player/T01.test.mjs (8 checks) exercises nav + lock transfer end-to-end; all three gates pass (verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T01 8/8). tasks.title: Add responsive breakpoints to home-hub and boot
tasks.notes: Implemented src/lib/prism/player/breakpoints.mjs (pure helper: classifyBreakpoint / resolveTransform / isVisibleAtBreakpoint) + .d.ts typings. Boot.ts picks currentBreakpoint from window.innerWidth (falls back to hub.layout.viewportWidth), filters nodes via isVisibleAtBreakpoint, resolves transforms via resolveTransform on both initial mount and SHR rebuildNode, exposes {currentBreakpoint, hiddenNodeIds} on window.__prism. home-hub.json gains transformByBreakpoint on 6 representatives (navbar-bg, hero-card-bg, feature-card-1-bg, settings-section-bg, stats-card-bg, footer-bg) and visibleAtBreakpoints excluding mobile on navbar-link-{editor,docs,pricing}+navbar-signin-btn. tests/lib/prism/player/T02.test.mjs — 35 checks across 5 phases (A helper, B data, C artifact, D boot wiring, E Playwright at 1920+720) all pass; verify:prism 15/15; browser-smoke 6/6. New artifactHash cfef6867f78c…. SHOULD-FIX (tracked): (a) fallback chain makes base transform unreachable at desktop-wide when a desktop override is declared — navbar-bg at 1920 resolves to the 1440 desktop override, not the base 1920; either declare desktop-wide explicitly on reflow nodes or treat base as implicit desktop-wide. (b) desktop-wide is a 4th key beyond schema extract L615-620 (desktop|tablet|mobile) — spec §10.15 names four viewports but schema names three; worth making §3/schema update explicit. (c) live resize not wired; mount-time-only currentBreakpoint. Window resize across 1024 leaves stale transforms. §10.15 admits mount-time reading but follow-up task should hook window.resize → reclassify + diff-rebuild. (d) only 6/40 nodes declare overrides; child elements of reflowed containers (hero-card-cta, headline/subhead, feature card icons/titles, footer links, etc.) will render off-screen at 720-wide. Wiring is proven; production mobile layout is not. (e) MountResult interface does not surface currentBreakpoint/hiddenNodeIds — only __prism debug handle does; non-debug consumers have to go through the global. (f) rebuildNode returns null for both hidden-at-breakpoint and missing-source — SHR repair cannot distinguish. OPTIONAL: breakpoints.d.ts could be breakpoints.d.mts for strict moduleResolution node16; classifyBreakpoint(NaN) defaults to desktop-wide (document); T02 phase-E depends on pre-existing .next build + artifact (brittle for hand runs).

tasks.title: Reconcile .prism artifact layout with §3.1
tasks.notes: Chose the additive path — kept both msdf metadata formats in the archive. build-msdf.mjs now runs generateBMFont twice (outputTypes 'xml' + 'json') and writes .fnt (pixi-consumable), .png (same bytes), and .msdf.json (BMFont JSON shape, pages[] normalised to 'font-inter.msdf.png'). build-prism.mjs bundles assets/font-inter.msdf.json alongside the existing .fnt+.png and hard-exits if it is missing (§10.19 demands exact §3.1 layout). Authored src/lib/prism/mock-app-source/schemas/shared-types.js — zero-dep descriptor-style schemas (HeroClickCounter, UserPreferences, AnalyticsSummary) with `specRef` fields that document the corresponding z.<x>() call a production build would compile. addDirIfPresent in build-prism.mjs picks up the new .js automatically. T03 test (tests/lib/prism/mock-app-source/T03.test.mjs) covers 11 checks: archive + manifest.entries presence for both new files, manifest.assets sha256+size entry for the .msdf.json, BMFont JSON shape (info/common/pages/chars) with required glyph fields, scaleW/scaleH↔PNG dim sanity, shared-types.js is valid ESM with ≥1 exported binding (+ dynamic-import smoke), HeroClickCounter+clickCount string presence, and on-disk source-of-truth existence. Spec-reviewer MUST FIX resolved: AnalyticsEvent (bogus {event,nodeId}) → AnalyticsSummary {totalClicks,sessions,avgSessionTime} per §6 line 1004-1005 + backends/analytics.js. Also resolved 2 SHOULD FIX inline: renamed `ref` → `specRef` on primitive descriptors; elevated build-prism missing-msdf.json branch from warn to exit(1). Browser-smoke first-run showed a borderline `runtime.mounted` timeout (still LOADING at 3.5s); second run and every subsequent run passed 6/6 cleanly — attributed to cold Next-start + ~5KB larger artifact; .fnt runtime bytes are identical. SHOULD-FIX (tracked, deferred): (a) build-msdf trust-two-parallel-runs-are-deterministic assumption is asserted in comment but not enforced; safer is to parse XML→JSON in-process or assert `xmlOut.textures[0].texture.equals(jsonOut.textures[0].texture)` after both runs to catch silent packer nondeterminism. (b) shared-types.js symbol naming `Number$/String$/Boolean$` — distinctive but shadow global constructors visually; `zNumber/zString/zBoolean` reads cleaner. (c) home-hub.json contract coverage gap — only hero-card-cta declares contracts; UserPreferences/AnalyticsSummary have no corresponding `contracts.outputs` entry on any node, so the schema module technically ships dead code from the graph's perspective. (d) Promise.all parallel generateBMFont is fine today but if the XML→JSON in-process path is adopted (see a), sequentialise to reduce heap pressure. OPTIONAL: build-prism's citation comment duplicates build-msdf's header.
